verdict.rationale: n8n's docs say it can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, on-premises or in a private cloud via Docker Compose or a one-line setup, and that it runs as the free Community edition without a license key. The GitHub repo supplies a curl install script, and multiple community users report self-hosting it for years. missing for 10: documentation of exactly which features are license-gated in the self-hosted Community edition (the license is fair-code, not OSI open source).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can self-host n8n on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, using Docker Compose, one-line setup, or other deployment methods.
Without a license key, n8n runs as the free Community edition.
A standard, self-hosted version of n8n is available on GitHub.
N8N is great. Been self-hosting for years.
